title: 危险能量控制：上锁挂牌
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/144_危险能量控制：上锁挂牌.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/144_危险能量控制：上锁挂牌/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一把红色挂锁和一张吊牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a red safety padlock and a blank danger tag, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第七课：危险能量控制，上锁挂牌。
overlay: 危险能量控制：上锁挂牌

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个配电箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a closed electrical distribution box on a laboratory wall.
shots.narration: 检修时，别让机器突然动起来。

shots.scene: 工程训练中心，老李要修一台机床
shots.prompt_en: In a university machine workshop, the facility engineer opens the guard of a lathe to repair it.
shots.narration: 实训中心，老李要拆罩修机床。

shots.scene: 他只按了停止按钮，没断电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stop button pressed on the lathe while the main power switch on the wall is still on. No text.
shots.narration: 他只按了停止键，电源还开着。

shots.scene: 阿杰走过来，伸手想按启动
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks up to the lathe and reaches toward the start button, not seeing the engineer.
shots.narration: 阿杰不知道，伸手就要开机。

shots.scene: 王老师大声喊住阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shouts and stops the young male student's hand just before it reaches the button.
shots.narration: 王老师：别动！里面有人在修！

shots.scene: 隔离开关被锁住，挂着吊牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an isolating switch in the off position secured with a red padlock and a blank danger tag. No text.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌：断开能量，锁住开关。

shots.scene: 锁防止合闸，牌告诉别人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a padlock icon blocking a hand from the switch, and a tag with a person icon telling others someone is working. No text.
shots.narration: 锁让人打不开，牌告诉别人为什么。

shots.scene: 检修的人在机器里，机器不会启动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker safely repairing inside a machine while the locked switch keeps it off, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 目的：防止检修时被误启动。

shots.scene: 防盗、交通图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burglar icon and a traffic light icon crossed out beside a locked switch. No text.
shots.narration: 不是防盗，也不是管交通。

shots.scene: 国家标准书和锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed national standard book beside a padlock and a tag. No text.
shots.narration: 国家标准对上锁挂牌有专门规定。

shots.scene: 六种能量图标围着一台设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one machine surrounded by six energy icons, electricity, a spring, compressed air, a hydraulic cylinder, a flame and a chemical drop. No text.
shots.narration: 危险能量，不只是电。

shots.scene: 压紧的弹簧、举起的部件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a compressed spring and a raised heavy part held up by gravity, each with a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 压紧的弹簧、举起的重物，也是能量。

shots.scene: 高温部件、管道里的化学品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot heating block and a pipe with chemical liquid, each with a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 高温部件、管里的化学品，也要隔离。

shots.scene: 老李对照设备图逐一列出能量源
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank equipment diagram and ticks each energy source one by one.
shots.narration: 动手前，把能量源逐一找全。

shots.scene: 拆防护罩维修前
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine with its guard being removed for repair, a lock icon above it. No text.
shots.narration: 拆罩维修前，先上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 警示带、口头告知不够
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning tape and a speech bubble beside a machine, both with a not enough icon. No text.
shots.narration: 拉警示带、打招呼，都不够。

shots.scene: 实验楼屋顶排风机检修，楼下配电箱上锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker repairing an exhaust fan on a laboratory roof while its power switch downstairs is locked and tagged. No text.
shots.narration: 修屋顶排风机，楼下电源也要锁。

shots.scene: 离心机、真空泵、通风柜风机图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a centrifuge, a vacuum pump and a fume hood fan, each with a small padlock. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室设备检修，同样要断能。

shots.scene: 检查、维修、保养、清理卡料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, an inspection magnifier, a wrench, an oil can and a hand clearing a jam. No text.
shots.narration: 检查、维修、保养、清卡料，都要断能。

shots.scene: 带电设备上干活打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand working on a live machine with sparks, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 在带电运转的设备上干活，非常危险。

shots.scene: 通知受影响的人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer telling lab users and colleagues that a machine will be shut down. No text.
shots.narration: 第一步：通知受影响的人。

shots.scene: 按正常程序停机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine control panel with the stop button pressed and the machine coming to rest. No text.
shots.narration: 第二步：按正常程序停机。

shots.scene: 断开隔离开关、关闭阀门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a main isolating switch turned off and a supply valve closed on a pipe. No text.
shots.narration: 第三步：断开开关、关闭阀门，隔离能量。

shots.scene: 一台设备上标出电、气、水三个隔离点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one machine with three marked isolation points, an electrical switch, an air valve and a water valve. No text.
shots.narration: 电、气、水，每个隔离点都要断开。

shots.scene: 只按停止键打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger on a stop button with the power line still live behind it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 停止按钮不是隔离，必须断开电源。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在断开的隔离开关上装锁具并挂个人锁（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands fitting a lockout device on an off isolating switch and closing a personal red padlock on it.
shots.narration: 第四步：用自己的锁，锁住隔离点。

shots.scene: 【实拍】挂上写好姓名的标签（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands hanging a filled in danger tag on the locked isolating switch, the writing blurred.
shots.narration: 牌上写明：谁在修、为什么修。

shots.scene: 钥匙放进自己口袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the padlock key going into the worker's own pocket. No text.
shots.narration: 一人一锁一钥匙，钥匙自己保管。

shots.scene: 多人检修，每人一把锁挂在锁扣上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multi lock hasp on a switch holding three padlocks from three workers. No text.
shots.narration: 几个人一起修，每人都挂自己的锁。

shots.scene: 阀门和插头也有专用锁具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a valve lockout cover and a plug lockout box, each with a padlock. No text.
shots.narration: 阀门、插头，用专用锁具锁住。

shots.scene: 储存的能量：气、液、弹簧、电容
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of stored energy, a pressurized pipe, a hydraulic cylinder, a spring and a capacitor. No text.
shots.narration: 第五步：放掉设备里残余的能量。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关闭气源阀门后打开排气阀，压力表指针回零（特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand opening a small bleed valve after the air supply valve is closed, a pressure gauge needle dropping to zero.
shots.narration: 关气源，再把管里的余压放掉。

shots.scene: 带压拔气管，管子甩出打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressurized air hose whipping loose after being pulled off, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带压拔管，管子会甩出伤人。

shots.scene: 管路里残留的化学品先排空
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: residual liquid drained from a pipe into a waste container before the pipe is opened. No text.
shots.narration: 管路里的化学品，先排空再拆。

shots.scene: 电容放电、部件放到最低处、等降温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capacitor being discharged, a raised part lowered to rest, and a hot part with a cooling clock. No text.
shots.narration: 电容放电、重物放下、等它降温。

shots.scene: 上锁后马上动手打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker reaching into a machine right after locking it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 锁上了，也别马上动手。

shots.scene: 【实拍】按下启动按钮，设备没有反应（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pressing the start button of a de-energised machine, nothing moves.
shots.narration: 第六步：试启动，确认真的启动不了。

shots.scene: 验电器测试无电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a qualified electrician testing a terminal with a voltage tester showing no voltage. No text.
shots.narration: 电气部分，由电工验电确认无电。

shots.scene: 未测试前一律当作带电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire with a question mark and a lightning icon, a hand held back. No text.
shots.narration: 没确认之前，一律当作有电。

shots.scene: 试完把按钮复位到停止
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after the test, the control switch returned to the off position. No text.
shots.narration: 试完，把开关复位再干活。

shots.scene: 别人的锁和牌，伸手打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand reaching to remove someone else's padlock and tag, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看到锁和牌，绝不能去合闸。

shots.scene: 只有挂锁的人本人取锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same worker whose name is on the tag removing his own padlock with his key. No text.
shots.narration: 谁挂的锁和牌，谁本人来摘。

shots.scene: 实验课改接线：开关挂禁止合闸牌
shots.prompt_en: In a teaching lab, the young male student hangs a blank do not switch on sign on an open switch while rewiring an experiment.
shots.narration: 实验课改接线，也挂禁止合闸牌。

shots.scene: 换班交接：先挂新锁，再摘旧锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: at shift change, a new worker adds his padlock before the first worker removes his own. No text.
shots.narration: 换班交接，先挂新锁再摘旧锁。

shots.scene: 挂锁人不在，负责人按程序处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supervisor checking that the worker is safe and off site before following a written procedure to remove a lock. No text.
shots.narration: 本人不在，由负责人按程序处理。

shots.scene: 清点工具，装回防护罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tools counted back into a toolbox and the machine guard put back on. No text.
shots.narration: 完工：清点工具，装回防护罩。

shots.scene: 确认所有人撤离危险区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supervisor checking that everyone has stepped away from the machine. No text.
shots.narration: 确认所有人都离开了危险区。

shots.scene: 通知相关人员，本人取锁送电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the worker telling colleagues, then removing his own lock and switching the power back on. No text.
shots.narration: 第七步：通知大家，本人取锁送电。

shots.scene: 试运行正常
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the repaired machine running normally with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 试运行正常，才算完工。

shots.scene: 电工持证上岗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a qualified electrician holding a blank operator certificate card next to a distribution box. No text.
shots.narration: 电气检修，由持证电工执行。

shots.scene: 高风险作业先办许可
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank work permit receiving a stamp beside a locked switch. No text.
shots.narration: 高风险检修，先办作业许可。

shots.scene: 培训和授权
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trainer teaching a small group how to apply a lock, then a blank authorization card. No text.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌的人，要经培训和授权。

shots.scene: 学生发现故障，挂停用牌并报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a blank out of service sign on a faulty instrument and phones the lab supervisor.
shots.narration: 学生发现故障：停用、挂牌、报告。

shots.scene: 学生拆设备打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student opening an instrument cover with a screwdriver, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不自己拆修设备。

shots.scene: 七步流程图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: seven icons in a row, a speech bubble, a stop button, a switch, a padlock, a gauge at zero, a start button test and a running machine. No text.
shots.narration: 通知、停机、隔离、上锁、放能、验证、恢复。

shots.scene: 一把锁一个人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one padlock linked to one worker icon and one key. No text.
shots.narration: 一人一锁，谁挂谁摘。

shots.scene: 清点、撤人、取锁、送电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a toolbox, people stepping back, a key opening a padlock and a power switch turning on. No text.
shots.narration: 完工清点，确认无人，再恢复送电。

shots.scene: 试启动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a start button with a hand and a no movement icon. No text.
shots.narration: 锁上以后，先验证零能量。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在吊车旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands near a small mobile crane outside a campus building and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：起重吊装与吊索具。
